arguments.text: Live Codex investigation, not synthetic replay. Routes: (A) falsify a small fixed first-denominator window conjecture, starting with one and two offsets; (B) turn exact divisor completions into infinite polynomial families; (C) combine modular families and inspect uncovered classes rather than declare total coverage. Compare original universal goal, auxiliary hypotheses proposed during this study and machine-checkable subclaims separately. Record budget exhaustion as inconclusive. Existing Agent cannot call its integer backend or certify whole polynomial families: these are concrete capability gaps to address. Public status must be checked against primary literature; no novelty claim.

proposal.falsifier: A valid n with no representation would refute the original; a failed restricted window only refutes that route. Missing modular classes block a covering proof.
proposal.rationale: Freeze exact original objective, exploratory route portfolio and falsifiers before new computation.
